limitations_and_boundaries: The study does not rule out the possibility that axonal material may also be engulfed.
Immunogold overexposure prevented observation of vesicle membranes around VGlut2 labeling.
The precise temporal dynamics of engulfment relative to synaptic pruning initiation are not fully resolved.
The study focuses on the retinogeniculate system; generalizability to other CNS regions requires further investigation.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
